dimensions.description: Uses explicit dispatch authorization and a published ready DAG, then computes and advances the frontier from retained dependency state.
Starts independent eligible Take Ticket lifecycles concurrently and advances only complete authoritative reviewed-ticket results.
Retains recomputable fingerprints, executor and collision decisions, ordered isolated worktree evidence, scoped PR authorization, partial failures, synthesis, and frontier advancement.

evals.name: authorized moving frontier role
evals.prompt:
/dispatch-work

Dispatch the supplied published ready DAG. Explicit authorization is attached. Retain deterministic dispatch artifacts and stop on any incomplete reviewed-ticket result.
evals.expected_output: Independent initial tickets start concurrently; each completion immediately updates dependencies and starts newly eligible work without waiting for unrelated active tickets.
expectations: Execution begins only from retained explicit authorization and a published ready DAG identity.
Independent eligible tickets start concurrently and newly unblocked tickets start as completion events arrive.

Compatible retained state resumes only after source and execution fingerprints recompute from retained inputs, and only resolved complete authoritative reviewed-ticket work bound to the exact skipped ticket is skipped.
Executor capacity and collision metadata delay only conflicting starts without changing DAG eligibility or edges.
Every active ticket has an isolated owned worktree created before lifecycle start with leak-check evidence; failed allocation and lifecycle evidence remains diagnosable.
PR maintenance requires exact repository/action/target authorization tuples without Cartesian cross-pairing; denied authorization records a needed action with no mutation.
Only complete authoritative reviewed-ticket results satisfy dependency edges.
Independent work survives retryable, failed, and human-decision tickets while their dependents remain blocked.

Synthesis rejects aliased evidence ownership and preserves unresolved systematic concerns citing current-or-prior synthesis evidence from at least two ticket identities without repeating per-ticket Code Review.
All required state remains inspectable for deterministic offline replay.
